_comment: Based on Cloudflare WAF Lua regex catastrophic backtracking outage 2019-07-02. https://blog.cloudflare.com/details-of-the-cloudflare-outage-on-july-2-2019/
incident: New WAF rule with unbounded alternation regex caused catastrophic backtracking in Lua regex engine, exhausting all CPU on all workers globally for 27 minutes

primary_fix_commit.message: fix: rollback WAF rule 100074 — LuaRegexEngine catastrophic backtracking
